stringUtils.ts.moduleOverview: Utility helpers for normalizing user-facing strings and locale-aware date formatting.

exports.name: capitalize
exports.description: Uppercases the first Unicode symbol in a string while preserving the remaining symbols.

returns.description: Original string with the first symbol converted to locale-aware uppercase, or an empty string when input is empty.

usageExamples: capitalize('ßeta') // 'SSeta' in locales where ß uppercases to SS
edgeCases: Returns an empty string when input is empty.
Handles surrogate pairs and extended grapheme clusters by splitting with Array.from.

exports.name: truncate
exports.description: Truncates a string by Unicode symbols and appends a single ellipsis when truncation occurs.

parameters.name: maxLength
parameters.description: Maximum number of symbols to keep including ellipsis when truncation is needed.

returns.description: Original string when short enough, otherwise a symbol-safe truncated string ending with an ellipsis.

edgeCases: Throws RangeError if maxLength is negative or not an integer.
Returns only an ellipsis when maxLength is 1 and input is longer than one symbol.

exports.name: formatDate
exports.description: Formats a Date with Intl.DateTimeFormat using configurable locale and medium date + short time styles.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Optional BCP 47 locale identifier; defaults to en-US.

edgeCases: Throws TypeError when date is invalid or not a Date instance.
Throws RangeError when locale is blank or whitespace.

ApiClient.ts.moduleOverview: HTTP client abstraction with retry, timeout, and structured API error handling.

exports.name: ApiError
exports.description: Error type carrying HTTP status, endpoint, and optional raw response details.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: HTTP status code associated with the failure.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Endpoint path used for the failed request.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Optional response body details for diagnostics.

returns.description: Constructed error instance that extends Error.

edgeCases: Used for both non-2xx responses and terminal retry failures.
Non-retriable 4xx errors are thrown immediately.

exports.name: ApiClient
exports.description: Client wrapper around fetch that enforces JSON responses, timeout, and exponential backoff retry policy.

parameters.name: baseUrl
parameters.description: Base origin used to resolve endpoint paths.

usageExamples: const profile = await api.request<{ id: string }>('/users/42')
edgeCases: Retries up to three attempts for network failures, aborts, and 5xx responses.
Throws ApiError when response JSON is not an object or array.

UserService.ts.moduleOverview: Domain service that loads users from the API layer and validates the resulting payload.

exports.name: User
exports.description: Domain contract describing the shape of a valid user returned by UserService.

returns.description: Strongly typed user object with identity, profile, and status fields.

edgeCases: Validation rejects malformed email or invalid createdAt timestamp.
Null API user payload is translated into UserNotFoundError.

exports.name: UserNotFoundError
exports.description: Domain-level error representing a missing user independent of transport concerns.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Identifier that could not be resolved.

returns.description: Constructed error instance with user-specific message.

usageExamples: if (error instanceof UserNotFoundError) { /* show empty state */ }
edgeCases: Thrown when API returns 404 status.
Thrown when API returns a successful response containing user: null.

exports.name: UserService
exports.description: Application service that depends on ApiClient and maps API failures to domain-specific errors.
edgeCases: Throws RangeError when id is blank.
Throws TypeError for structurally invalid user payload fields.

UserCard.tsx.moduleOverview: Dashboard-style React component that loads and renders a user profile with loading and error states.

exports.name: UserCardProps
exports.description: Props contract defining the selected user id and injected UserService dependency.

parameters.name: userService
parameters.description: Service responsible for loading user data.

edgeCases: Renders loading view while async request is in progress.
Renders error panel when UserService throws.

exports.name: UserCard
exports.description: Functional component using useEffect and useState to fetch and display profile attributes.

parameters.name: props
parameters.description: Component props controlling requested user and service dependency.

returns.description: Styled card UI with profile metadata and status badges.

edgeCases: Cancels stale updates with an isCurrent guard when component unmounts.
Dependency array includes userId and userService to avoid stale requests.
